related.title: DNS 名稱壓縮：指標偏移與往返解碼
related.titleEn: DNS name compression: pointer offsets and round-trip decoding
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：第5項研究的可複查條件：接受115僅限明示階層及無額外DNSSEC/CNAME查詢；真實解析可能需更多。 交接時須能核對：交付 dns-hierarchy.csv、cache-events.csv與冷熱查詢分類圖。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Investigation 5 review criterion: Accept115 only for this hierarchy without extra DNSSEC/CNAME work; real resolution can need more queries. Handover must also reconcile: Deliver dns-hierarchy.csv, cache-events.csv and classified cold/warm query plots.
related.difference: 逐字節記錄原名稱及指標位置，指標偏移以整個DNS訊息起點為基準。
related.differenceEn: Record names and pointer positions byte by byte, measuring offsets from the DNS message origin.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice:
遞迴解析可重用referral快取；權威查詢量取決於名稱、區域與快取狀態。
教學基準：5+10+100 = 115 queries；對照：100*3 = 300 queries。所有數值、事件、期限與門檻是本課明示的合成教學情境，並非官方設備規格、營運網路量測或部署建議。

DNS壓縮指標用兩位元組指向訊息內既有名稱片段；解析必須防止越界及循環。
教學基準：20*40 = 800 B；對照：40+19*(28+2) = 610 B。所有數值、事件、期限與門檻是本課明示的合成教學情境，並非官方設備規格、營運網路量測或部署建議。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn:
Recursive resolution can reuse referral caches; authoritative query count depends on names, zones and cache state.
Teaching baseline: 5+10+100 = 115 queries; comparison: 100*3 = 300 queries. All numeric inputs, events, timers and limits are explicit synthetic teaching conditions, not official equipment specifications, operational-network measurements or deployment recommendations.

DNS two-octet compression pointers reference name fragments inside the message; decoding must reject bounds violations and cycles.
Teaching baseline: 20*40 = 800 B; comparison: 40+19*(28+2) = 610 B. All numeric inputs, events, timers and limits are explicit synthetic teaching conditions, not official equipment specifications, operational-network measurements or deployment recommendations.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: TCP：序號環繞與位元組確認範圍
related.titleEn: TCP: sequence wraparound and byte acknowledgement ranges
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：第5項研究的可複查條件：接受115僅限明示階層及無額外DNSSEC/CNAME查詢；真實解析可能需更多。 交接時須能核對：交付 dns-hierarchy.csv、cache-events.csv與冷熱查詢分類圖。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Investigation 5 review criterion: Accept115 only for this hierarchy without extra DNSSEC/CNAME work; real resolution can need more queries. Handover must also reconcile: Deliver dns-hierarchy.csv, cache-events.csv and classified cold/warm query plots.
related.difference: 畫出環繞前16 B與環繞後資料區間，禁止直接用普通整數大小判斷新舊。
related.differenceEn: Split pre-wrap16 B and post-wrap ranges and avoid ordinary integer comparison for serial ordering.

related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.

TCP序號使用32位元環狀空間；確認號指向下一個期待位元組，SYN/FIN也各消耗序號。
教學基準：4294967280+40-2**32 = 24 sequence number；對照：4294967280+80-2**32 = 64 sequence number。所有數值、事件、期限與門檻是本課明示的合成教學情境，並非官方設備規格、營運網路量測或部署建議。

TCP uses a32-bit sequence space; ACK names the next expected byte, and SYN/FIN each consume a sequence number.
Teaching baseline: 4294967280+40-2**32 = 24 sequence number; comparison: 4294967280+80-2**32 = 64 sequence number.
